title: Toxic threats from plastic waste: human health impacts, challenges, and policy solutions

Plastic pollution is a global crisis, harming ecosystems and human health. Plastics release toxic compounds like BPA, dioxins, and heavy metals, bioaccumulate in food chains, and persist due to poor waste management, especially in low-income regions.
